headline: Meta pauses Muse chat sharing after exposure of private conversations
summary: Meta suspended Muse's conversation-sharing feature after researchers found thousands of shared chats, including sensitive personal and business details, publicly accessible online.

claims.statement: Meta paused Muse's conversation-sharing feature after researchers found shared chat links publicly exposed online.

sources.quote: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web
Meta suspends Muse chats sharing feature after it left private details exposed
The company is suspending the feature after security researchers discovered how easy it was to access sensitive information shared with the AI assistant.

claims.statement: Researchers found thousands of shared Muse conversations exposed, including sensitive personal and business information.

sources.quote: A single query is all that's required to find thousands of conversations listed by title.
Researchers accessed 6,800 shared conversations with the AI agent, including internal company documents.

claims.statement: Researchers at the security firm Claroc found the exposed Muse links through public DNS records.

sources.quote: Meta says it paused a Muse feature that lets you share conversations with the AI assistant after researchers found the URLs publicly available on the web, as reported by Ars Technica. In a report published this week, researchers at the security firm Claroc say they found more than 6,800 Muse links through public DNS records.

discrepancies.explanation: Ars Technica says one query surfaces thousands of exposed conversations, while The Verge and Engadget cite a more specific count of over 6,800 found links.

quotes.quote: A single query is all that's required to find thousands of conversations listed by title.
Researchers accessed 6,800 shared conversations with the AI agent, including internal company documents.
